dog.description_text:
A volunteer writes:
Lovely wears well her name. She is a gentle and welcoming senior who seems to have lived through some kind of accident. Indeed, she came in limping and with a fracture of her mandibule already repaired by our veterinary team(a wire has to be removed on 12/7). Lovely has been a good girl from day one at the care center and is always happy to see visitors, indulging in pets and sweet words(see her video). She might have some arthritis and likely would do best in a quiet home with a new owner who loves seniors. We think that she is the perfect lapcat!! Lovely would love to meet you, spend her golden years with you and offer you the most wonderful companionship ever! Come and meet Lovely at the Manhattan Care Center!
dog.name: Lovely
